# app/usb_descriptors.c at tag firmware-v1.1.1), read on the host with the
# chip unique ID 00600015 39365006 20313148. One per line:
#   <formats> <speed> <name> <bytes in hex>
# <formats> as the formats command takes them; <speed> high or full, the
# speed the device runs at; <name> device, qualifier, configuration,
# other_speed (the other speed's configuration), or string0 to string3
# (language ID 0x0409).
